title: Goa Tour Package
overview: The quintessential Goa holiday designed with balance: relax in luxury South Goa resorts, walk through vibrant Portuguese heritage streets in Fontainhas, and explore North Goa’s chic cafes and sunset cruises.
highlights: 4 Nights in 4★ Boutique Beach Resort with daily buffet breakfast
Private sunset river cruise on Mandovi with Goan live folk music
Guided walking photography tour of Fontainhas Latin Quarter
Day trip to South Goa beaches (Palolem, Agonda & Cabo de Rama Fort)
Dedicated private AC cab for all tours and transfers
inclusions: 4 Nights stay in 4★ boutique beach resort
Private airport pickup and drop off (GOX or GOI)
Full day North Goa sightseeing & Full day South Goa beaches tour
exclusions: Water sports activity packages (can be booked at jetty)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa & Sunset Beach Walk
itinerary.description: Warm pickup at Mopa (GOX) or Dabolim (GOI) airport. Transfer to your beach resort. Relax by the pool and take a leisurely sunset walk along the beach.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Poolside relaxation and tropical welcome drink
itinerary.eveningActivity: Sunset walk at Candolim/Benaulim beach shack
itinerary.stay: Hard Rock Hotel / Heritage Village Resort 4★, Goa

itinerary.title: North Goa Forts, Water Sports & Mandovi Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Visit Aguada Fort overlooking the Arabian Sea, Sinquerim beach for parasailing and jet skiing, followed by a romantic sunset catamaran cruise on the Mandovi River.
itinerary.eveningActivity: Sunset Mandovi River Cruise with live DJ and folk dance
itinerary.stay: Hard Rock Hotel / Heritage Village Resort 4★, Goa

itinerary.title: Fontainhas Latin Quarter & Old Goa Heritage Churches
itinerary.description: Explore the UNESCO heritage Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in Old Goa. Afterwards, walk through the colourful Portuguese Latin Quarter of Fontainhas and taste warm Bebinca at a 100-year-old bakery.
itinerary.eveningActivity: Dinner at quaint Goan-Portuguese courtyard bistro in Assagao
itinerary.stay: Hard Rock Hotel / Heritage Village Resort 4★, Goa

itinerary.title: Pristine South Goa: Cabo de Rama Fort & Palolem Beach
itinerary.description: Head to the untamed beauty of South Goa. Clamber up the cliffside ruins of Cabo de Rama Fort for turquoise sea panoramas, followed by dolphin watching and kayaking at Palolem beach.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Cabo de Rama cliff viewpoint
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Kayaking & beach shacks at Palolem and Agonda
itinerary.stay: Hard Rock Hotel / Heritage Village Resort 4★, Goa

itinerary.title: Goa Souvenirs & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast, morning dip in the sea, and transfer to airport with sun-kissed memories.
